fft_normalization: one-sided power |FFT/M|^2; double interior bins only

definitions.function: DC scan from -1.10 V to +1.10 V; output codes 0..63 and 6 bit resolution
definitions.DNL: sampled-input sine amplitude/DC correction; observed endpoint line; full code bins between measured transitions only
definitions.INL: residual from the endpoint line through first and last measured transitions, divided by nominal LSB
definitions.THD: 10 log10(folded harmonic power sum / fundamental power)
definitions.ENOB: (SNDR-1.76)/6.02; SNDR is used internally for ENOB calculation
definitions.resolution: Slow differential ramp; average LSB is (transition code 63 - transition code 1) / 62, accepted from 28.125 to 34.375 mV/LSB.
definitions.range: Slow differential ramp; actual range is V1 to V63 and must cover -0.9*VRP to +0.9*VRP; out-of-range saturation is checked.

resolution_method: slow differential ramp -1.10 V to +1.10 V; average (V63-V1)/62
range_method: slow differential ramp -1.10 V to +1.10 V; actual range V1 to V63
